_about: Homestead exemption amounts used in the buyer tax estimate, and the post-sale reset rules, with official sources. Update yearly from the sources below; do not edit numbers from memory.

source.title: 2026 NAL, SDF and NAP Users Guide, field 110 (EXMPT_01)

additional.statute: s. 196.031(1)(b), F.S.; indexed annually to CPI starting 2025

source.title: Additional Homestead Exemption Adjustment (2026: CPI change 2.7%, maximum $26,411)

additional.crossCheck: 2026 NAL, SDF and NAP Users Guide, field 111 (EXMPT_02): 'up to $26,411'

homestead.rule: Except as provided in this subsection or subsection (8), property assessed under this section shall be assessed at just value as of January 1 of the year following a change of ownership.

nonHomesteadResidential.rule: Except as provided in this subsection, property assessed under this section shall be assessed at just value as of January 1 of the year following a change of ownership or control.

_notIncluded: Portability (moving a Save Our Homes benefit from a previous Florida homestead): depends on the buyer, so it is not estimated.
Senior, veteran, disability, widow(er) and similar exemptions: personal to the owner.
Non-ad valorem assessments: not in the DOR tax roll files.
